subject: Ousmane Dembele
title: Dembele: from Ballon d'Or to seventh

lines.vo: The reigning Ballon d'Or winner just finished seventh.
lines.footage: Dembele Ballon d'Or 2025 archive, trophy lift

lines.vo: Ousmane Dembele won last year's award. This year, in London, he came seventh. Still top ten.
In 2024-25 he scored thirty-three goals and made fifteen assists. Those were first-place numbers.
Harry Kane won with 1,055 points. Dembele had 418. That is more than double.
lines.footage: Harry Kane Ballon d'Or 2026 acceptance clip

lines.vo: Even Lionel Messi, playing in Miami, finished fifth, two places higher.
PSG are top of Ligue 1 with twenty-three points after ten games. Seventh place has not hurt the table.
lines.footage: PSG match highlights, Parc des Princes

lines.vo: PSG also signed Torres, Godts and Akliouche this summer. So Dembele has company.

inserts.story: A cartoon shelf holds a golden ball labelled last year. A caricature Dembele polishes it so hard that the ball shrinks to the size of a seventh-place medal. He holds it up and says, still shiny.
inserts.characters: caricature Dembele; generic cartoon shelf with a face; no real people

inserts.story: A cartoon podium has seven steps. A caricature Dembele stands on step seven, and a tiny caricature Messi on step five leans down and hands him a pair of binoculars. The label says, for spotting the winner.
inserts.characters: caricature Dembele; caricature Messi (tiny, waving); no real people beyond the two caricatures

inserts.story: A cartoon dressing room has three new generic signings squeezing onto a bench. A caricature Dembele finds his peg taken by a pigeon in football boots. The pigeon coos politely, as if it were the fourth signing.
inserts.characters: caricature Dembele; generic cartoon pigeon in boots; generic cartoon signings; no real people

facts_used: Dembele finished 7th in the 2026 Ballon d'Or with 418 points; Kane won with 1,055; ceremony at the London Palladium (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Ballon_d%27Or)
Messi finished fifth in the same vote (https://www.si.com/soccer/lionel-messi-2026-ballon-dor-ranking-revealed)
2024-25: 33 goals and 15 assists in 49 games; Ballon d'Or won 22 Sep 2025 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ousmane_Demb%C3%A9l%C3%A9)
PSG top of Ligue 1 with 23 points after ten games (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Ligue_1)
Summer arrivals Akliouche, Torres and Godts (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Paris_Saint-Germain_FC_season)
notes: Dembele's presence in the late-October and November matches is not confirmed by the sources, so the script makes no claim about his form in those games. 'Dembele now has company' is an inference, not a documented squad fact. The Strasbourg penalty story rests on one French Wikipedia source and is not used. Injury, family, religion and the 2021 hotel incident are excluded. after_line counts from 1. Punch-up pass: 'more than double' is checked (2 x 418 = 836, below 1,055). 'First-place numbers' refers to his 2024-25 season, which won the 2025 award. 'Seventh place has not hurt the table' makes no claim about his own form.
